newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * President Emil Constantinescu will hold a news conference on Thursday to present a state-of-the-nation report on his first 200 days in office. Government representatives are expected to attend.
The national radio plans a live broadcast of the event starting 1100 hours local.
* White House officials announced that U.S. President Bill Clinton's European tour after the NATO summit in Madrid in July would include Romania.

* Romania is fully committed to reform and integration into the NATO and the European Union and no external decision can divert it from its aims, President Constantinescu told a EuroForum seminar on investment opportunities in Romania.

* Former foreign minister Teodor Melescanu is holding a news conference following his resignation from the main opposition Party of Social Democracy (PDSR) last week. Melescanu is expected to announce he will be setting up a new party together with fellow reformists who also quit PDSR.
* Romanian concert manager Marcel Avram is facing a trial in Munich, Germany, on alleged tax evasion. Avram admitted to tax evasion worth some nine million German marks.
